title: Reception/entrance area with thermal CCTV monitor and turnstiles
objects_and_counts: In the photographed scene (not counting images shown on displays) there are at least two visible people: one person seated at a desk behind glass (center left region, partially obscured by a dual-monitor stand) and one person standing near the turnstiles (center right region) wearing a face mask; both are fully visible in the scene.

A large flat-panel monitor is visible in the foreground (occupying lower half of the image) displaying a multi-view CCTV/thermal application; a separate pair of monitors is mounted on a tall stand in the mid-background (near the center of the image) and are visible as two black screens back-facing the camera.

There is a reception/console counter in the foreground right that contains a desk telephone (visible keypad and handset) and a control panel with multiple labeled push buttons and indicators (panel located inside the console, lower right region).

Four waist-high glass-and-stainless-steel turnstile gates are visible in a row immediately beyond the reception area (center-right region); the visible portion shows at least three clear gate assemblies and parts of a fourth, some with green indicator lights on top.
Seating: one blue cube seat (right region) and one grey ottoman or bench (right region) are visible near the far right wall.
One desk and chair are visible behind the glass partition where a seated person is working (center-left background).

On-screen video feeds show additional people who are present only in the displayed footage: the monitor foreground shows at least two people in the camera views (one standing in a corridor and one captured in a thermal view) — these are part of the displayed CCTV images, not additional people physically present in the photographed scene.

The reception/console counter is in the foreground right; the control panel and telephone are recessed into this counter and the counter surface extends left-to-right across the mid-foreground.

A row of glass-and-stainless-steel turnstiles is directly beyond the reception counter toward the center-right of the image; the seated desk and worker are visible behind glass to the left of the turnstiles.
Informal seating (blue cube and grey ottoman) sits against the far right wall beyond the turnstiles and reception area.

The glass partition separates the reception/monitor area (foreground) from the workspace and circulation corridor behind it; the person standing near the turnstiles is between the glass partition and the far wall.
